function_revised: Small integral membrane protein, candidate accessory subunit of the mycobacterial respiratory cytochrome bcc:aa3 supercomplex: its fold matches actinobacterial supercomplex membrane subunits (HHpred, the strongest of this set: 7Q21 Cgl2017 / 7E1V, E~0.24) and it is under strong purifying selection (pN/pS 0.2). CAVEAT: structural-fold candidacy ONLY; no genomic, co-expression or structural-modelling corroboration that it is a bona fide subunit.
evidence: HHpred (Neff 1.94): 5/5 top hits to respiratory-supercomplex membrane proteins (7E1V PRSAF1 M.smegmatis/M.tb 82%; 9GY6 cytochrome bc mycobacterial 89%; 7Q21 Corynebacterium supercomplex 89%); DeepTMHMM transmembrane; strong purifying

HHpred web (MPI Bioinformatics Toolkit, profile-profile remote homology), interpreted in project 'Still unknown gene function', 2026-06-10. A fold/family-level assignment, not a demonstrated function.

Case-study refutation (2026-06-12): the 5 small dark membrane/lipoproteins originally flagged as supercomplex subunits are dispersed (0.4-3.2 Mb), none near qcrCAB(Rv2194-6)/ctaCDE, STRING anchors are genomic neighbours (regulators/methyltransferases) NOT respiratory genes, and no literature/structure models them as subunits -> fold resemblance only, NOT a validated functional module.

literature.summary: No publication mentions this gene in its title or abstract — not under its H37Rv locus tag, not under its gene name, and not under any ortholog identifier. Its annotation rests on sequence/structure evidence, with no primary study behind it.
